entries.def:
Λώτ, ὁ (Heb. לוֹט), indecl., 
Lot (Gen.11.27, al.): Luk.17.28-29, 32, 2Pe.2.7.†
(AS)

Μαγαδάν
Magadan, an unidentified place on the coast of the Sea of Galilee: Mat.15.39 (Rec. Μαγδαλά; cf. Mrk.8.10, where for Δαλμανουθά, D* has Μελεγαδά, D1 Μαγαιδά, some cursives Μαγαδά, and Euseb. Onomast. Μεγαιδάν; cf. DB, iii, see word).†
Μαγδαλά (Aram. מַגְדְֺּלָא = Heb. H4026, which in Jos.15.37 B is rendered Μαγαδά), 
Magdala: Mat.15.39 (Rec. for Μαγαδάν, which see).†
(AS)

Μαγδαληνός, -ά, όν 
Magdalene, of Magdala: Μαρία (which see) ἡ MM., Mat.27.56, 61; 28.1, Mrk.15.40, 47; 16.1, 9, Luk.8.2; 24.10, Jhn.19.25; 20.1, 18†
(AS)

μαγία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ 
(μάγος), 
__1. the lore of the Magians (Plat.). 
__2. magic: pl., magic arts, sorceries: Act.8.11.†
(AS)

μαγεύω (Eur., Plut., al.), 
__1. to be a Magus, or skilled in Magian lore. 
__2. to practise magic: Act.8.9.†
(AS)

μάγος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX for אַשָּׁף, Dan LXX TH Dan.2.2, 10, al. (cf. chief magian, Jer.39.3, 13) ;] 
__1. one of the Μάγοι, a Median tribe (Hat). 
__2. a Magian, one of a sacred caste, originally Median, who seem to have conformed to the Persian religion, while retaining some of their old beliefs (see DB, I vol., 565 f.; DB, iii, 203 ff.): Mat.2.1, 7; 2.16 
__3. a wizard, sorcerer: Act.13.6, 8 (cf. Wis.17.7, Act.8.9…

Μαγώγ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מָגוֹג, Gen.10.2, Exo.38.2, al.), 
Magog, associated with Gog: Rev.20.8 (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

Μαδιάμ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מִדְיָן), 
Midian; 
__1. son of Abraham (Gen.25.2). 
__2. An Arabian tribe (Gen.36.35, Psa.83.9, al). 
__3. γῆ Μ. (Heb. מִדְיָן אֶרֶץ), the land of Midian (Exo.2.15, al.): Act.7.29.†
(AS)
